<mapper namespace="com.hanwha.management.biz.mapper.AuthMapper">

    <select id="selectUser" resultType="com.hanwha.extension.service.user.dto.UserDto">
        SELECT seq, site_cd, user_id, user_name, user_password as password, activated, last_access_time,
               last_access_ip, reg_seq, mod_seq, reg_dt, mod_dt
        FROM "TB_FWK_USER" WHERE user_id = #{userId} and site_cd = #{siteCd}
    </select>

    <select id="selectRoleUser" resultType="com.hanwha.extension.service.role.dto.RoleUserDto">
        SELECT *
        FROM "TB_FWK_ROLE_USER" WHERE user_seq = #{seq}
    </select>

    <update id="updateAccessInfo" parameterType="com.hanwha.extension.service.user.dto.UserDto">
        UPDATE "TB_FWK_USER" SET last_access_time=#{lastAccessTime}, last_access_ip =#{lastAccessIp}  WHERE user_id = #{userId}
    </update>

</mapper>
